shots.focal_element: A large white arrow cursor in the centre between two dimmed, desaturated app-icon tiles (an AI-chat icon left, a code-host icon right with a red '0' notification badge).
shots.what_happens: A very brief beat (about a third of a second, over w26-w27 'because Work') on a near-black background: greyed-out app icons sit quietly, a red badge reads 0 and a third tile is cut off at the bottom right, setting up the notification explosion of the next shot. Only the persistent corner ClickUp watermark is visible as text (not listed).
shots.build_rebuild: On a #000-ish full-frame background, place two 140px rounded-square app icons at 40% opacity with grayscale filter, a centred white cursor sprite and a red circular badge reading 0, hold for ~8 frames then hard-cut.

shots.focal_element: Giant two-line headline 'WORK SPRAWL' with a pink-to-violet-to-blue gradient fill and soft glow, overlaid by a swarm of app icons with climbing red notification badges.
shots.typography: Headline: geometric sans, extra-bold, all caps, very large, tight tracking, gradient fill with outer glow, stacked two lines. Captions: same family, bold, lowercase sentence case, white, centred under the headline, swapped phrase by phrase in sync with the VO; outgoing phrase blurs/dims as the next one sharpens. Font guess (low confidence): a geometric grotesk such as Plus Jakarta Sans.
shots.what_happens: As the VO says 'Work Sprawl has scattered the tools and contexts we rely on' (w27-w37), app icons (mail, AI chat, code host, video meeting, design tool, team chat, cloud drive) pop in around and over the headline while their red badges count up rapidly (roughly 1 to 24 across the shot), large icons enter from the frame edges at different scales, and a cursor darts between them clicking; the caption phrase under the headline changes with each spoken phrase, then the composition slightly pulls back toward the end.
shots.build_rebuild: Render a centred two-line gradient headline with a blurred duplicate behind it for glow, spawn 8-10 rounded app-icon cards with staggered pop-in (scale 0.6 to 1 with overshoot) and per-icon red badges whose integers increment every ~120ms, animate a cursor between icons, and swap a white caption line under the headline on each VO phrase with a blur-out/blur-in.

shots.focal_element: Presenter (man with glasses in a patterned purple shirt) on the right-centre third against a black studio background, with words appearing in the upper-left negative space.
shots.typography: Bold geometric sans, white, lowercase, tight tracking, top-left aligned, wrapping to a second line; each word appears as it is spoken with a short motion-blurred slide/blur-in.
shots.what_happens: Medium shot of the presenter speaking to camera; the caption builds word by word in sync with w38-w41 ('And the trend towards'), the newest word arriving with motion blur.
shots.build_rebuild: Over a locked-off presenter clip, render a top-left text block that appends one word per VO word timestamp, each word entering with a 6-frame blur(8px)-to-0 and small upward slide.

shots.focal_element: A glowing glossy sphere with a pink-to-blue gradient that holds tilted office-suite app icons (documents, spreadsheets, slides, mail, cloud storage, intranet), with stacked caption words on the left.
shots.transition_other: Detector flagged a non-hard-cut change from s009; the first frame keeps the same presenter framing with the caption now enlarged to include 'BUNDLING SOFTWARE', so it reads as a jump re-layout or zoom; not verifiable at 2 fps.
shots.typography: Lead-in lines in bold white lowercase sans; 'BUNDLING' in extra-bold all caps with pink-to-blue gradient and 'SOFTWARE' in white all caps, both large. Later caption words are bold white sentence-case, stacked one word per line at top-left, with 'of the problem' stacked bottom-right, right-aligned; older words fade/blur as new ones arrive.
shots.what_happens: Starts on the presenter with the 'and the trend towards BUNDLING SOFTWARE' caption (w38-w43), then the frame whip-pans or slides left with heavy motion blur to reveal the glowing sphere packed with office-suite icons that drift and rotate gently inside it; the words 'isn’t addressing the root' build top-left and 'of the problem' lands bottom-right (w44-w50), with a sparkle/chime SFX in anchors (x013 near 15.8s) as the sphere arrives.
shots.build_rebuild: Slide the presenter layer out to the left with a 0.3s motion-blurred push while a radial-gradient circle (pink to blue, white rim glow) with 6 tilted app icons slides in from the right, then append VO-timed caption words stacked top-left and right-aligned bottom-right.

shots.composition_other: Shifts within the shot: centred orb with flanking words, then centred word in a particle field, then presenter centred with split words left/right, then a giant year behind the presenter, then centred captions over full-bleed monochrome photos.
shots.focal_element: The shattering app sphere and the gradient keywords ('SYSTEM'S', 'TIME.', '2017') that punctuate the presenter's lines.
shots.transition_other: Detector flagged a non-hard-cut change; the sphere from s010 shrinks and continues into this shot while 'problem' blurs out, reading as a continuous scale/blur hand-off.
shots.typography: Mixed: small white all-caps sans for 'THE' and 'BROKEN'; 'SYSTEM'S' and 'TIME.' in bold all caps with pink-violet-blue gradient and glow; 'wasting our' bold white lowercase stacked, left of presenter; '2017' huge extra-bold gradient numerals behind the presenter; '8 YEARS AGO' white bold caps at the bottom (partly occluded); 'we started' and 'with the mission:' small white lowercase captions; 'clickup' is the logo printed on a T-shirt in the footage.
shots.what_happens: A multi-beat montage in one detected shot over w50-w67: the icon sphere shrinks between 'THE' and 'SYSTEM'S', bursts into a confetti-like particle field with the icons flying outward around the word 'BROKEN' (w51-w53); the presenter returns with 'wasting our' left and gradient 'TIME.' right (w55-w58); a giant gradient '2017' appears behind him with an '8' counter becoming '8 YEARS AGO' (w59-w61); then black with 'we started', grayscale footage of a person in a ClickUp shirt ('we started ClickUp', w62-w64) and a grayscale team photo at a booth with 'with the mission:' appearing word by word (w65-w67). Many internal changes (4 events in anchors) are too fast to confirm at 2 fps.
shots.build_rebuild: Sequence these sub-beats on VO word timestamps: scale the icon orb to 40% then replace it with a particle burst (300 small gradient shards with outward velocity and fade) while the icons fly to the edges; cut to presenter with left/right caption blocks; place a large gradient '2017' text layer behind a rotoscoped presenter; finish with grayscale photo plates under centred word-by-word white captions.

The contact-sheet frame at 0:24.000 instead shows the 'SAVE' footage from the next shot, so the exact frame boundary is uncertain.

shots.focal_element: The word 'SAVE' centred over grayscale footage of a man in a flat cap and headphones studying a monitor.
shots.typography: Single word, all caps, medium-to-bold white geometric sans, centred, with slight letter spacing; same style as the previous flash cut.
shots.what_happens: A 6-frame flash cut (about 0.25s) synced to w69 'save': a new grayscale B-roll plate with 'SAVE' centred. It continues the rapid word-per-cut montage of people at work that illustrates the mission statement.
shots.build_rebuild: Hard-cut to a new desaturated B-roll clip on the word timestamp and show that VO word centred in white caps for the clip's duration, repeating per word to build a rhythmic word-per-cut montage.
